description: Use this when the user has a 17-character VIN and wants to know what the vehicle is (year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, body, assembly plant), whether the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) is on file for that VIN, how many recalls were issued for the model, and where to find the paint code. Covers vehicles sold new in the US; original stickers are on file mainly for recent Ford, Lincoln, Jeep, Ram, Dodge, Chrysler, Chevrolet, GMC, Cadillac, Buick, Toyota, Lexus, Hyundai, Kia and Nissan models. It does not return accident, title or ownership history.

vin.description: The 17-character Vehicle Identification Number. Letters I, O and Q never appear in a VIN.
